**A 6.7-magnitude earthquake struck 62 km NNW of Yelizovo, Russia, on 2026-11-28 at 13:15 UTC**

### What changed
- 307,439,400 records of living things were observed in 2025 (GBIF), up from 307,421,900. Unit: records, date: 2025-01-01, source: GBIF
- 14,548,790 research works were published in 2025 (OpenAlex), up from 14,532,580. Unit: works, date: 2025-01-01, source: OpenAlex
- 282,495,600 animal records were observed in 2025 (GBIF), up from 282,486,100. Unit: records, date: 2025-01-01, source: GBIF

### Worth a look
- **biodiversity-records-by-year**: Tracks global animal and plant records over time. Shows how species observations grow annually.
- **research-papers-by-year**: Reveals trends in global scientific output, including AI and open-access research.

[Full dataset file](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/datasets/biodiversity-records-by-year.csv)

**A 5.1-magnitude earthquake struck 107 km SSE of Auki, Solomon Islands, on 2026-11-27**

### What changed
- Animal records observed in 2025: 282,486,100 (records), date: 2025-01-01, source: GBIF
- Plant records observed in 2025: 21,737,200 (records), date: 2025-01-01, source: GBIF
- Human Development Index: Afghanistan 0.502 (2025), Angola 0.624 (2025), Albania 0.864 (2025), source: UNDP

### Worth a look
- *biodiversity-records-by-year*: Tracks animal and plant records by year, with full historical data. Shows trends in species observation over time.
- *human-development-index*: Compares national development across countries with HDI scores from 1990 to 2025.

**Africa’s daily calorie supply in 2024 is 2568**

### What changed
- Africa’s daily calorie supply per person is **2568** in 2024 (unit: calories), from FAO data (2024), source: food-supply dataset.  
- The strongest earthquake of the past day was **5.7** magnitude near Revilla Gigedo Islands region at 2026-11-26 15:26 UTC, per USGS.  
- The global estimate of armed conflict deaths in 2025 is **108,907** in Africa (unit: deaths), from UCDP data (2025), source: conflict-and-security dataset.  

### Worth a look
- Explore *food-supply* for daily calorie and meat per person by region, updated to 2024.  
- Check *democracy-and-rights* for electoral democracy index (V-Dem) trends from 1789 to 2025.
